title: Data Analyst Intern
description:
Knowcraft Analytics, an ISO 27001 certified organization, provides comprehensive offshore solutions to accounting, advisory, taxation, and valuation firms in the US and Canada. Our team includes qualified CFAs, CPAs, MBAs, and CAs with extensive experience in supporting end-to-end engagements. Knowcraft is recognized as a Great Place to Work. Over the last thirteen years, we have become a partner of choice for 40+ financial services and advisory firms in the US and Canada, having carried out end-to-end valuation engagements as well as accounting, advisory and taxation projects.

Role and Responsibilities

**Generate, maintain, and analyze daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports across departments.**

**Extract data from different tracking tools and structure it into meaningful insights.**

**Prepare productivity and performance dashboards for internal management review.**

**Coordinate with internal teams to ensure accurate data flow and timely report generation.**

**Prepare customized reports and presentations for clients as per requirements.**

**Perform data audits to ensure integrity and highlight anomalies.**

**Automate repetitive reporting tasks where feasible.**

**Assist in developing KPIs/metrics and maintain historical data logs.**

Skills & Competencies:

**Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Power Query, etc.).**

**Familiarity with BI tools like Power BI or Tableau (preferred).**

**Excellent analytical, data interpretation, and visualization skills.**

**High attention to detail with a structured approach to problem-solving.**

**Strong communication and coordination skills.**

Qualifications and Education Requirements

**Bachelor’s or master’s degree in commerce, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field (Completed/ Pursuing)**

What We Offer

**Dynamic work environment with cross-functional collaboration.**

**Opportunities for upskilling in data analysis and BI tools.**

**Exposure to client-facing reporting and process automation.**

**Performance-driven culture with emphasis on innovation and growth.**

Pay: ₹9,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Business Data Analyst
description:
Responsibilities:

* Define measurement frameworks and metrics with product and engineering teams.
* Build and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and reports.
* Analyse product, behavioural, and model data to surface actionable insights.
* Support experiment design and A/B test analysis.
* Ensure data quality and consistency across sources.
* Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards using **Tableau Desktop** and **Tableau Cloud**.

* **SQL:** Advanced (CTEs, Subqueries, Window Functions, Complex Joins)

* Ability to interact confidently with clients and collaborate with multiple teams

Nice To Have (Not Obligatory):

* Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift).
* Familiarity with ML workflows and model evaluation metrics.
* Familiarity with GitLab for versioning analysis code and pipelines.
* Exposure to healthcare or SAAS products.

Pay: ₹480,000.00 - ₹660,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Tableau: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical **Business Analyst** to work closely with the Managing Director. The role will involve analysing business data, preparing MIS and management reports, tracking KPIs, monitoring departmental performance, and providing actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work directly with the Managing Director on business analysis and strategic initiatives.
* Prepare **daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports** for management review.
* Analyse sales, revenue, collection, expenses, project, and departmental performance.
* Track **KPI/KRA performance** across departments and highlight gaps.
* Prepare dashboards and management presentations using **Excel, Power BI, or similar tools**.
* Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate with department heads to collect and validate business data.
* Monitor project-wise and department-wise targets versus actual performance.
* Prepare **variance analysis** and provide reasons for major deviations.
* Maintain management trackers and ensure timely submission of required reports.
* Support the MD in business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and decision-making.
* Conduct data analysis for new projects, business opportunities, and process improvements.
* Follow up on action points assigned by the Managing Director and maintain an **Action Tracker**.
* Ensure data accuracy, confidentiality, and timely reporting.
* Present key findings and insights to the Managing Director in a clear and concise manner.

**Required Skills**

* Strong **analytical and problem-solving skills**.
* Advanced knowledge of **MS Excel** — Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, dashboards, charts, etc.
* Knowledge of **Power BI / Data Visualization** will be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of MIS, KPIs, business reports, and performance analysis.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in **Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field**.
* MBA / PGDM in Business Analytics, Finance, or Management will be an advantage.

**Preferred Experience**

* **Fresher to 2 years** of experience as a Business Analyst, MIS Analyst, Management Analyst, or similar role.
* Experience in **Real Estate, Construction, or other project-based industries** will be preferred.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Data Analyst Internship
description:
We are looking for a motivated Data Analyst Intern to support our data team in collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data. This internship is ideal for students or recent graduates who want to gain hands-on experience in data analysis and business decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources
* Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends and patterns
* Create reports, dashboards, and visualizations
* Assist in interpreting data and providing actionable insights
* Work with teams to understand business requirements
* Support data validation and ensure data accuracy
* Document processes and findings

Education:

* Higher Secondary(12th Pass) (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
